fields.name: Commercial Treadmill
fields.usage: High-performance commercial treadmill built for endurance training, fat loss, and professional gym usage. Designed with powerful motor capacity, advanced cushioning, and smart console features.

fields.name: Manual Treadmill
fields.usage: Self-powered treadmill designed for natural walking and jogging without electricity. Ideal for home workouts, rehab training, and low-impact cardio sessions.

fields.name: Curved Treadmill
fields.usage: High-performance self-powered curved treadmill designed for sprint training and HIIT workouts. Enhances natural running form and burns more calories compared to traditional treadmills.

fields.name: Elliptical Trainer
fields.usage: Low-impact cardio machine that simulates walking, running, and climbing motions while reducing stress on joints. Ideal for full-body workouts combining upper and lower body movement.

fields.name: Air Walker
fields.usage: Lightweight, low-impact cardio machine that simulates a walking or gliding motion in the air. Commonly used for gentle workouts, rehabilitation, and beginner-friendly fitness routines.

fields.name: Stationary Bike (Upright Bike)
fields.usage: Indoor cycling machine designed to simulate outdoor biking. Provides effective cardiovascular workouts with adjustable resistance and compact design.

fields.name: Upright Bike
fields.usage: Classic indoor cycling machine that mimics outdoor bicycle posture. Provides effective cardiovascular workouts with adjustable resistance and compact design for home and gym use.

fields.name: Recumbent Bike
fields.usage: Ergonomic stationary bike with a reclined seating position and back support. Designed for maximum comfort, low-impact cardio, and rehabilitation-focused workouts.

fields.name: Spin Bike (Indoor Cycling Bike)
fields.usage: High-intensity indoor cycling machine designed for endurance training, fat loss, and professional cycling workouts. Features a heavy flywheel and road-bike style posture for realistic riding experience.

fields.name: Air Bike (Assault Bike / Fan Bike)
fields.usage: High-intensity cardio machine using air resistance and dual-action handles. Resistance increases with effort, making it ideal for HIIT, CrossFit, and full-body conditioning workouts.

fields.name: Rowing Machine
fields.usage: Full-body cardio machine that simulates rowing motion using a sliding seat and resistance system. Engages legs, back, arms, and core simultaneously for strength and endurance training.

fields.name: Water Rowing Machine
fields.usage: Premium rowing machine using water resistance to simulate real on-water rowing. Provides smooth, natural motion with dynamic resistance based on user effort.

fields.name: Magnetic Rowing Machine
fields.usage: Low-noise, full-body cardio machine using magnetic resistance for smooth and controlled rowing workouts. Ideal for home gyms due to quiet operation and adjustable resistance levels.

fields.name: Stair Climber
fields.usage: High-intensity cardio machine that simulates stair climbing motion. Provides powerful lower-body workout while improving cardiovascular endurance and calorie burn.

fields.name: Stepper Machine
fields.usage: Compact cardio machine that simulates stair stepping motion using hydraulic or resistance-based pedals. Ideal for lower-body workouts, home fitness, and fat-burning routines.

fields.name: Arc Trainer
fields.usage: Advanced cardio machine combining elements of elliptical and stair climber with a unique arc motion. Designed for high-calorie burn, joint-friendly workouts, and full lower-body engagement.

fields.name: Ski Erg
fields.usage: Upper-body focused cardio machine that simulates cross-country skiing using a pull-down motion. Designed for strength, endurance, and core training with high calorie burn.

fields.name: VersaClimber
fields.usage: Vertical climbing cardio machine that simulates continuous climbing motion using both arms and legs. Provides one of the most intense full-body workouts with low joint impact.

fields.name: Chest Press Machine
fields.usage: Seated strength machine designed to target chest, shoulders, and triceps through a controlled pressing motion. Provides a safer alternative to free-weight bench press with guided movement.

fields.name: Incline Chest Press Machine
fields.usage: Inclined pressing machine designed to target the upper chest (clavicular head), shoulders, and triceps with a natural pressing angle.

fields.name: Decline Chest Press Machine
fields.usage: Strength machine designed to target the lower chest muscles (sternal head) using a downward pressing motion. Provides controlled movement for safe and effective chest development.

fields.name: Pec Deck Machine (Butterfly Machine)
fields.usage: Isolation machine designed for chest fly movement, targeting the pectoral muscles. Also supports reverse fly variation for rear deltoid training.

fields.name: Smith Machine
fields.usage: Guided barbell system fixed within steel rails allowing vertical or near-vertical movement. Designed for safe, controlled strength training without requiring a spotter.

fields.name: Power Rack (Squat Rack / Power Cage)
fields.usage: Open or enclosed steel cage system designed for free-weight barbell training with adjustable safety bars. Essential for performing squats, bench press, and heavy lifts safely.

fields.name: Half Rack
fields.usage: Compact open-frame strength rack designed for barbell training with safety spotter arms. Provides essential functionality of a power rack while saving space.

fields.name: Squat Rack (Squat Stand)
fields.usage: Basic barbell support structure designed primarily for squats and presses. Offers adjustable height settings for versatile strength training with minimal space usage.

fields.name: Leg Press Machine
fields.usage: Lower-body strength machine designed to target quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes through a controlled pressing motion. Available in 45° plate-loaded and horizontal selectorized variants.

fields.name: Hack Squat Machine
fields.usage: Plate-loaded lower-body machine designed to simulate squat movement with back support. Targets quadriceps primarily while reducing balance and stability requirements.

fields.name: Leg Extension Machine
fields.usage: Isolation machine designed to target the quadriceps by extending the knee against resistance. Provides controlled movement for focused muscle development and rehabilitation.

fields.name: Seated Leg Curl Machine
fields.usage: Isolation machine designed to target hamstrings by flexing the knee while seated. Provides controlled resistance for safe and effective posterior leg training.

fields.name: Lying Leg Curl Machine
fields.usage: Prone-position isolation machine designed to target hamstrings through knee flexion. Provides strong contraction and stretch for effective posterior leg development.

fields.name: Glute Bridge Machine (Hip Thrust Machine)
fields.usage: Plate-loaded or selectorized machine designed to target glutes through hip thrust/bridge movement. Provides safer and more controlled alternative to barbell hip thrusts.

fields.name: Hip Thrust Machine
fields.usage: Specialized lower-body machine designed to target glutes through hip extension movement. Offers a safer and more stable alternative to barbell hip thrusts with guided motion and belt/pad support.

fields.name: Hip Abduction Machine
fields.usage: Isolation machine designed to target outer thigh muscles (gluteus medius and minimus) by moving legs outward against resistance. Commonly used for glute shaping and hip stability.

fields.name: Lat Pulldown Machine
fields.usage: Upper-body strength machine designed to target the latissimus dorsi (back muscles) through a vertical pulling motion. Essential for building back width and strength.

fields.name: Seated Row Machine
fields.usage: Horizontal pulling machine designed to target the middle back, lats, rhomboids, and biceps. Provides controlled rowing motion for strength and posture improvement.

fields.name: T-Bar Row Machine
fields.usage: Plate-loaded rowing machine designed for heavy back training. Targets lats, rhomboids, traps, and rear delts using a horizontal pulling motion with chest support for stability.

fields.name: Low Row Machine (Seated Cable Row)
fields.usage: Strength machine designed for horizontal pulling movement targeting mid-back, lats, and rear delts. Provides controlled cable-based resistance for safe and effective training.

fields.name: Pull-up Machine (Pull-up Station)
fields.usage: Bodyweight training station designed for upper-body pulling exercises like pull-ups and chin-ups. Targets lats, biceps, shoulders, and core using natural body movement.

fields.name: Assisted Pull-up Machine
fields.usage: Strength machine designed to assist users in performing pull-ups and dips using a counterweight system. Ideal for beginners and progressive strength training.

fields.name: Shoulder Press Machine
fields.usage: Seated strength machine designed to target deltoid muscles (front and middle shoulders) through an overhead pressing motion. Provides controlled and safe alternative to free-weight shoulder press.

fields.name: Lateral Raise Machine
fields.usage: Isolation machine designed to target the lateral (middle) deltoid muscles through a controlled outward arm raising motion. Essential for building shoulder width and definition.

fields.name: Rear Delt Machine (Reverse Pec Deck)
fields.usage: Isolation machine designed to target the rear deltoids and upper back through a reverse fly motion. Often integrated with pec deck machines for dual functionality.

fields.name: Bicep Curl Machine
fields.usage: Isolation machine designed to target biceps through a controlled curling motion. Provides strict form and consistent resistance for effective arm development.

fields.name: Preacher Curl Machine
fields.usage: Isolation machine designed for strict bicep training using a fixed preacher pad. Eliminates momentum and ensures maximum bicep contraction throughout the movement.

fields.name: Tricep Pushdown Machine (Cable Pushdown Station)
fields.usage: Cable-based strength machine designed to isolate triceps through a downward pushing motion. Commonly used with rope, bar, or V-handle attachments.

fields.name: Dip Machine (Assisted / Bodyweight Dip Station)
fields.usage: Upper-body strength machine designed for dip exercises targeting chest, triceps, and shoulders. Available in assisted (counterweight) and bodyweight versions for different fitness levels.

fields.name: Multi Gym Machine (Multi-Station Gym)
fields.usage: All-in-one strength training system combining multiple exercise stations into a single unit. Allows full-body workouts including chest, back, arms, legs, and core.

fields.name: Functional Trainer
fields.usage: Dual adjustable cable machine designed for functional, multi-directional training. Allows users to perform a wide range of exercises targeting all muscle groups with natural movement patterns.

fields.name: Cable Machine (Cable Crossover / Pulley Machine)
fields.usage: Versatile strength machine using cable and pulley systems to provide constant tension throughout movement. Used for a wide range of exercises targeting all muscle groups.

fields.name: Ab Crunch Machine
fields.usage: Selectorized core machine designed to isolate abdominal muscles through a controlled crunching motion. Provides resistance-based core training with proper spinal support.

fields.name: Abdominal Bench (Ab Bench)
fields.usage: Adjustable bench designed for bodyweight abdominal exercises like sit-ups, crunches, and leg raises. Allows incline and decline angles for varied intensity.

fields.name: Decline Bench
fields.usage: Angled workout bench designed for decline abdominal exercises and strength training. Increases workout intensity by positioning the body below horizontal level.

fields.name: Roman Chair (Hyperextension Bench)
fields.usage: Bodyweight training equipment designed for lower back, glutes, and core strengthening through hyperextension and stabilization exercises.

fields.name: Hyperextension Bench (Back Extension Bench)
fields.usage: Bodyweight training bench designed for strengthening lower back, glutes, and core through controlled hyperextension movements. Commonly used for posterior chain development and injury prevention.

fields.name: Captain’s Chair (Vertical Knee Raise Station)
fields.usage: Bodyweight training station designed for abdominal and core exercises like knee raises and leg raises. Includes back support and arm pads for stability.

fields.name: Ab Coaster
fields.usage: Unique core machine that trains abdominal muscles through a bottom-up lifting motion along a curved rail. Minimizes neck and lower back strain while maximizing abdominal contraction.

fields.name: Torso Rotation Machine (Rotary Torso)
fields.usage: Selectorized machine designed to train oblique muscles through controlled rotational movement. Enhances core strength, stability, and rotational power.

fields.name: Cable Woodchopper Setup
fields.usage: Functional cable-based setup used to perform rotational woodchopper exercises. Targets obliques, core, and stabilizer muscles through diagonal pulling movements.

fields.name: Medicine Ball
fields.usage: Weighted ball used for strength, conditioning, and functional training exercises. Commonly used for throws, slams, and core workouts.

fields.name: Wall Ball
fields.usage: Soft-shell weighted ball designed for wall throws, squats, and functional training. Commonly used in CrossFit and HIIT workouts to build strength, coordination, and endurance.

fields.name: Stability Ball (Swiss Ball / Exercise Ball)
fields.usage: Inflatable exercise ball used for core training, balance, and stability exercises. Widely used in fitness, physiotherapy, and rehabilitation programs.

fields.name: BOSU Ball (Balance Trainer)
fields.usage: Half-dome inflatable stability trainer used for balance, core strength, and functional workouts. Can be used dome-side up or down for varied training intensity.

fields.name: Ab Wheel Roller
fields.usage: Compact core training tool used for rollout exercises that target abs, shoulders, and lower back. Requires strong stabilization and control, making it effective for advanced core training.

fields.name: Resistance Bands
fields.usage: Elastic training bands used for strength, mobility, and rehabilitation exercises. Provide variable resistance and are widely used for full-body workouts.

fields.name: Suspension Trainer (TRX)
fields.usage: Bodyweight training system using adjustable straps anchored to a fixed point. Allows functional, full-body workouts using gravity and bodyweight resistance.

fields.name: Core Sliders (Gliding Discs)
fields.usage: Lightweight sliding discs used to perform dynamic core and full-body exercises. Create instability and continuous tension by allowing controlled sliding movements on different surfaces.

fields.name: Balance Board (Wobble Board)
fields.usage: Stability training device used to improve balance, coordination, and core strength by creating an unstable surface.

fields.name: Yoga Mat (Exercise Mat)
fields.usage: Cushioned mat designed for yoga, stretching, and floor exercises. Provides comfort, grip, and stability during workouts.
